email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Technology Coordinator role at Reynaers Group. With a technical background in web development and hands-on experience managing marketing websites and their integrations, I am drawn to the opportunity to support the MarTech ecosystem behind reynaers.com and related platforms.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I build and optimize WordPress sites, implement structured data, and work with APIs and analytics tools to improve search visibility and user experience. I have coordinated with external developers, managed content updates, and translated technical requirements into clear actions for non-technical stakeholders. My experience with JavaScript, PHP-adjacent environments, and tools like Google Analytics and Search Console aligns well with the technical and analytical aspects of this role.

I am eager to contribute to Reynaers Group's international marketing technology team and help drive digital maturity. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing Technology Coordinator position at Reynaers Group. With a technical foundation in computer science and practical experience in digital marketing and web development, I have developed a strong interest in the intersection of marketing, web technology, and data. The opportunity to support the MarTech platforms behind reynaers.com and its ecosystem aligns perfectly with my skills and career aspirations.

In my freelance work and as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have built and optimized WordPress websites, implemented structured data and JSON-LD schema, and used analytics tools like Google Analytics and Search Console to track performance. I have also worked with APIs and integrations, coordinating with external developers to ensure smooth deployments and resolving technical issues. For example, I built a multi-page website for a Belgian youth chess champion, where I implemented knowledge-graph markup and ran iterative technical SEO audits that measurably improved search health. This experience has taught me how to translate business priorities into structured technical solutions and to communicate complex topics clearly to non-technical audiences.

My background in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) and my familiarity with PHP environments from WordPress customization give me a solid basis to quickly understand Drupal and the broader MarTech stack. I am comfortable coordinating releases, validating requirements, and ensuring integrations between platforms like PIM, DAM, TMS, and CRM run smoothly. I am also eager to deepen my knowledge of GA4, Looker Studio, and BigQuery, and to contribute to user adoption through training and best practices.

I am structured, solution-oriented, and enjoy making complex technology accessible. I am fluent in English and have a working knowledge of Dutch, which I am actively improving. I would welcome the chance to bring my mix of technical and marketing skills to Reynaers Group and help build the digital foundations for your marketing organization.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Hands-on experience building and optimizing WordPress websites, including custom landing pages with structured data and accessible markup
• Implemented JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, and llms.txt for improved search visibility and AI search readiness
• Coordinated with external developers and managed releases for client websites, ensuring smooth deployments
• Proficient in Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs for performance tracking and technical SEO audits
• Technical background in JavaScript and front-end development, with familiarity with PHP environments through WordPress customization
